name: Kapa Foods - Wholesale Food Supplier
old_description: Kapa Foods has been family owned and operated since 1985 proudly providing businesses such as restaurants, supermarkets, caterers and more with quality food products, cleaning products, paper products and much more. We emphasize the importance of freshness in our products, which is why we pick up fresh meat, seafood, and produce daily from Boston’s wholesale market and deliver it straight to your business
about:
Kapa Foods, based in Webster, Massachusetts, has been family-owned and operated since 1985. The company began as a wholesale food supplier serving local businesses in the region.

The distributor sources fresh meat, seafood, and produce daily from Boston's wholesale market and delivers directly to customers using its own six-truck fleet. It offers same-day delivery with no delivery fee, supplying a broad range of products including fresh and frozen meats, seafood, dairy, produce, dry goods, cleaning supplies, and paper goods.

Kapa Foods serves restaurants, supermarkets, caterers, schools, hotels, nursing homes, golf courses, catering companies, churches, festivals, social clubs, special events, and flea markets throughout the area.

The company emphasizes freshness and customer experience, highlighting daily market pickups, accurate order fulfillment, and fast turnaround as key differentiators in a competitive food-service supply market.
